LanguageData.Dyze_PathogenicResidue_Enable_Desc: If enabled, sick pawns may leave pathogenic residue as they move.
LanguageData.Dyze_PathogenicResidue_AffectColonistsOn: If enabled, only colonists can leave pathogenic residue.
LanguageData.Dyze_PathogenicResidue_RequireMovement_D: If enabled, pawns only leave residue after moving to a different cell.
LanguageData.Dyze_PathogenicResidue_DebugLogging_Desc: If enabled, the mod writes extra diagnostic messages to the RimWorld log.
LanguageData.Dyze_PathogenicResidue_UseMovementHook_D: If enabled, residue is checked when pawns move instead of through periodic map scanning. Requires Harmony.
